lines.text: On a stormy coast lies Saltreach, a small harbor town.
For years, Keeper Elena Vos lit the lighthouse every night.
Three nights ago, the light went dark. No one has seen Elena since.
Ships now sail by guesswork, and the harbor is full of rumors.
Captains are arriving from every island to help.
You are one of them. Find out what happened, and bring the light back.
Look around, and say hello to the other captains.
The sky outside your window was the right answer.
Inside lies a small brass key for the lighthouse lamps.
Three lamps need three captains. Find two more.
The beam sweeps across the water again.
Ships turn toward the harbor, and Saltreach cheers.
The light is back. Elena's story is not over yet.
